_comment: Story gates: items from these namespaces/IDs can't be worn or right-click used until the player has the KubeJS stage (granted by FTB Quests command rewards: /kubejs stages add @p <stage>). Hero-pack namespaces filled 2026-10-28 from the mod jars on the test PC (fsang = FSang18's Heroes, ~1636 item models; satsu_iron_man_addon = Satsu Iron Man Addon); confirm against kubejs/exported/tt_item_namespaces.json after the next launch. Gods and Heroes (Palladium) isn't in the CurseForge pack yet, so its namespace is still open.

gates.message: The suit's systems stay dark. Its makers' secrets are revealed in Chapter 8: The Rise of Heroes.

_dimensions_comment: Dimension gates: a player without the stage can't travel into these dimensions (portals just don't fire; startup_scripts/tt_dimension_gates.js). Chapter mapping from docs/00-kickoff.md: Ch7 The Shattered Realms opens the Aether, Twilight Forest, Undergarden and Blue Skies; Ch11 The Final Convergence opens the Otherside (Deeper and Darker). For testing: /kubejs stages add @p tt_ch7_realms (or tt_ch11_convergence). Set enabled to false to switch all dimension gates off.

gates.message: The portal shivers but won't open. The Shattered Realms answer only to a Shard-Born who has reached Chapter 7.
Something on the other side pushes back. The Convergence is not ready for you yet (Chapter 11).
